caption: The drawing depicts a bird’s-eye view of a formal garden and its surroundings encircled by a wooden fence. In the foreground, there is a large, light beige building with a red-tiled roof and a staircase leading to an entrance. Adjacent to the building is a rectangular garden area divided by walkways into four main sections, featuring symmetrical flower beds with various colors such as green, yellow, blue, and red, as well as geometrically arranged shrubs and trees. Some areas of the garden are patterned in circles and semicircles, while others are rectangular plots with rows, likely for growing vegetables or other plants. There are several people scattered throughout the garden and grounds, engaging in walking or gardening activities. In the background, outside the fenced garden, there are a few houses with red roofs among green grassy areas, and further back, there are sandy beige areas leading to a body of water. The shoreline has a boat pulled up on the sand, a few visible rocks in the water, and two small buildings on the grassy area closer to the shore. The entire scene uses a palette dominated by greens for grass and trees, blues for water, beiges and browns for buildings and paths, and reds for the roofs and some flowers.
title: Whitehall Estate and Garden
